name: lionfox_fixtl
description: Adds /fixtl for recovering players stuck mid-translocate. /fixtl clears the Entity.Teleporting flag. /fixtl unstick additionally clears EntityPlayer.ignoreTeleportCall (via reflection) and re-broadcasts Pos. /fixtl go bypasses BlockEntityTeleporterBase.HandleTeleportingServer entirely — finds the pad you're standing on, resolves its destination via GetTarget/tpLocation, and TeleportToDoubles you there directly (workaround for the gamemode-shift case where warmup runs but the BE loop never actually fires the teleport). /fixtl diag dumps Teleporting/IsTeleport, Pos and PreviousServerPos with the movement delta between them, MountedOn, ignoreTeleportCall, NoClip, CollisionBox, GameMode, and nearby teleporter BEs' tpingEntities entries — full report mirrored to the server log. Admin subcommands: /fixtl status, /fixtl all, /fixtl player <name>.
